column2: PeopleSpheres is a unified HR platform that unifies various human resource management systems and data. It allows users to access and report on employee information through a single interface, streamlining HR processes and enhancing compliance. Key features include automated reporting, customizable workflows, an AI data advisor for personalized insights, and support for multiple industries such as construction, retail, and logistics.
